sents.text: For example: ls dash l, greater-than, listing dot txt saves the listing.
echo, run two done, double greater-than log dot txt adds a line to a log.
And python train dot py, two greater-than errors dot txt keeps the errors in their own file, so you can read them later.
The vertical bar is a pipe.
It takes the output of the command on the left and feeds it straight in as the input of the command on the right, with no temporary files.
cat data dot csv, pipe, head dash n three shows just the first three lines.
grep keeps only the lines that contain a word.
uniq dash c counts repeated lines, but only when they sit next to each other, so sort first.
And wc dash l counts what's left.
